title: Wall Mount Ladder Towel Bar 30-Inch 4-Tier Solid Brass | Carolina Collection Allied Brass
description:
Add vertical towel storage with a wall mount ladder towel bar that makes efficient use of bathroom space. This Carolina collection towel bar features a 30 in center-to-center span and four horizontal bars in a traditional, classic design suited to heritage bathroom fixtures and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Ladder-style towel rack / towel holder with 4 bars for hanging or drying multiple towels
- Wall-mounted installation helps save floor space while keeping towels within reach
- Crafted of solid brass with a durable designer finish
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, traditional look
- Coordinate with matching Carolina collection pieces for unified traditional bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Overall dimensions: 30 in L x 35 in H x 3.3 in projection
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Mount type: Wall mount; assembly required: No
- Included: Ladder towel bar and installation hardware (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: multiple lifetime designer finishes available, including distinctive statement colors
